note: Both sets capture the same core facts (bolt diameter 3/8", L3X3X1/4 profiles, overall lengths 12'-3 3/4" for Module A and 10'-3 3/4" for Module B, and the 5/16" bolt callout in the Module A detail). Set A additionally records the L3X3X1/4 member profile for Module B, an important fact the drawing shows and Set B omits. However, Set A also repeats the 3/8" through-bolt claim and attaches 'S-301' (a sheet/detail reference, not a condition) to it, which is an unsupported, duplicated claim. On balance A captures more correct engineering content, with one redundant/unsupported claim, while B is clean but incomplete.
remarks: Both sets bind the three loose dimension strings (3'-8 3/8", 3'-6", 3'-1 5/16") to a generic 'PV Detail' entity with a generic 'dimension' attribute; in the drawing these belong to the C1 (Module B) detail and could be bound more specifically. The 5/16" value appears only as a small callout near the bolts in the Module A detail and is not clearly labeled as a bolt size in the text layer, so the 'bolt type 5/16"' claim in both sets is only weakly supported. Many other dimension strings and the L3X3X1/4 callouts in the details are unclaimed by both sets.
